name: iTerm2 cat RCE
tile_line: Public exploit: cat a file, run code. Update to 3.7.9.
summary: In iTerm2 before 3.7.9, displaying a crafted file in the terminal, for example with `cat README.md`, runs commands on your Mac. The trap is hidden in the file and doesn't show up in the output, and it works on a default install in bash, zsh and fish. The researcher published a complete exploit; iTerm2 fixed it in 3.7.9 on 20 Nov 2026. No attacks are reported. There's no fixed release for macOS 12, whose newest iTerm2 is 3.6.11.

affected.label: iTerm2 before 3.7.9
affected.text: The researcher says every version with Kitty image support is affected; iTerm2 added it in 3.5.4beta2 (September 2024). iTerm2 3.6.11, the newest release for macOS 12, came out on 2 Jun 2026, before the fix, and 3.6.9's source has the same flawed code.

affected.label: It shows files from others
affected.text: The file's raw contents have to reach iTerm2: `cat` on a README from a cloned repo or a download is the researcher's example, and any file you might print counts. The hidden part doesn't appear in the output. No setting needs to be changed for it to work.

do.label: Update to 3.7.9
do.text: In iTerm2, choose iTerm2 > Check for Updates. 3.7.9 is a security update: replies iTerm2 sends back to programs no longer include control characters that a shell could run.

do.label: On macOS 12? No fix yet
do.text: 3.7.9 needs macOS 13 or later, and the 3.6 line hasn't had a release since 3.6.11 (2 Jun 2026). Upgrade macOS if you can; until then, don't print files from others in iTerm2.

do.label: No setting turns it off
do.text: The "Disable potentially insecure escape sequences" setting doesn't cover the escape sequence this uses, per the researcher. Updating is the fix.

slack: iTerm2 cat RCE (no CVE yet): in iTerm2 before 3.7.9, displaying a crafted file (e.g. cat README.md) runs commands, on a default install, in any shell. Full exploit public since 21 Nov, no attacks reported, not in KEV. Fix: iTerm2 3.7.9 (20 Nov, Check for Updates). macOS 12's newest iTerm2 is 3.6.11 (June), with no fix.

sources.title: ii4gsp (Minseong Kim): write-up, affected versions, full exploit
